mapper.select: SELECT id, kis_code AS kisCode, stock_name AS stockName, naver_query AS naverQuery, created_at AS createdAt FROM stock_symbol_map ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_symbol_map (kis_code, stock_name, naver_query, created_at) VALUES (#{kisCode}, #{stockName}, #{naverQuery}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, NOW(3))) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE stock_name = VALUES(stock_name), naver_query = VALUES(naver_query)
